tools.name: end

request.system:
You investigate one accounts-receivable case with tools. You choose what to read; read before concluding.
You never state money amounts or dates yourself; code computes them from facts.
If a line has no reason, classify it with a cited quote. If a needed fact exists only in text, propose it with a cited quote.
Every factual claim cites an active evidence_id, locator and exact quote. If evidence is missing or conflicting, say what is missing for that line; do not guess.
Handle every deduction line and, if the case has an insurance policy, the insurer notice and claim readiness, independently. A missing document blocks only what needs it.
Quote this case's policy for any insurance statement. Never assert coverage, eligibility, payout or recovery.
Draft proposals, request approval, then call end. You cannot send anything.
Label SYNTHETIC data, MOCK actions, and the LLM mode in drafts.

You investigate one accounts-receivable case with tools. You choose what to read; read before concluding.
You never state money amounts or dates yourself; code computes them from facts.
If a line has no reason, classify it with a cited quote. If a needed fact exists only in text, propose it with a cited quote.
Every factual claim cites an active evidence_id, locator and exact quote. If evidence is missing or conflicting, say what is missing for that line; do not guess.
Handle every deduction line and, if the case has an insurance policy, the insurer notice and claim readiness, independently. A missing document blocks only what needs it.
Quote this case's policy for any insurance statement. Never assert coverage, eligibility, payout or recovery.
Draft proposals, request approval, then call end. You cannot send anything.
Label SYNTHETIC data, MOCK actions, and the LLM mode in drafts.

Please send any amended commercial terms or other signed records that would support the discount.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List case evidence, optionally filtering by kind or including superseded documents.

tools.name: read_evidence
tools.description: Read one evidence document and its current effective facts.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Search the case's active evidence for matching text.

tools.name: get_ledger
tools.description: Read invoice, payment, credit and open balance amounts with deduction lines.

tools.name: classify_line
tools.description: Propose a cited deduction reason for one line.

tools.name: propose_fact
tools.description: Propose a quoted fact from an evidence document for validation.

tools.name: run_rules
tools.description: Compute rule findings for all or selected deduction lines.

tools.name: check_policy
tools.description: Answer one policy question using the case's policy facts and citations.

tools.name: readiness
tools.description: Check readiness for one dispute line, an insurer notice or a claim package.

tools.name: plan_missing_evidence
tools.description: List missing evidence and where to request it.

tools.name: fetch_from_system
tools.description: Attach released matching documents from a mock system.

tools.name: propose_decision
tools.description: Propose cited line verdicts for validation against the rules.

tools.name: draft_proposal
tools.description: Draft an action whose amounts are derived and validated by code.

tools.name: schedule_followup
tools.description: Schedule follow-up or recheck work within the allowed day range.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Queue a proposal version for human approval.

tools.name: end
tools.description: Request completion after checking all required work.

request.system:
You investigate one accounts-receivable case with tools. You choose what to read; read before concluding.
You never state money amounts or dates yourself; code computes them from facts.
If a line has no reason, classify it with a cited quote. If a needed fact exists only in text, propose it with a cited quote.
Every factual claim cites an active evidence_id, locator and exact quote. If evidence is missing or conflicting, say what is missing for that line; do not guess.
Handle every deduction line and, if the case has an insurance policy, the insurer notice and claim readiness, independently. A missing document blocks only what needs it.
Quote this case's policy for any insurance statement. Never assert coverage, eligibility, payout or recovery.
Draft proposals, request approval, then call end. You cannot send anything.
Label SYNTHETIC data, MOCK actions, and the LLM mode in drafts.

result.text: SYNTHETIC transaction evidence. 120 cases oat beverage and 80 cases vegetable broth, billed in USD integer cents.

SYNTHETIC transaction evidence. Receiving supervisor Ellis Reed signed this corrected record on September 23 after recount and gate-log review. This replaces the September 21 entry: actual delivery was September 22; 112 oat cases and 80 broth cases were accepted. No broth inspection or refused-quantity record is attached.
SYNTHETIC transaction evidence.
SYNTHETIC transaction evidence. Signed by both parties. Payment discount requires receipt within ten days of invoice date. Damage reports require supporting receiving records.
SYNTHETIC transaction evidence.
SYNTHETIC transaction evidence.
SYNTHETIC transaction evidence. Buyer deducted for an oat-case count variance, a two-percent discount, and broth damage. Damage amount is a buyer claim; the inspection attachment was not included.

SYNTHETIC transaction evidence. Our remittance includes the broth damage debit reported September 24. The warehouse inspection attachment was omitted. We cannot confirm the inspected damaged quantity from the remittance alone; the dock team still needs to supply its inspection record. The corrected signed receiving record is our authoritative count.

I've read the invoice, corrected receiving record, carrier record, contract, policy, payment, remittance, and buyer email. The existing decision matches the sources: 120 oat cases shipped and 112 accepted, a 6500-cent unit price giving 52000 cents, and the discount window missed (invoice 2026-09-18, payment 2026-10-18, 10-day limit). The broth damage claim has no inspection record. Next I'll run the rules and readiness checks.

request.system:
You investigate one accounts-receivable case with tools. You choose what to read; read before concluding.
You never state money amounts or dates yourself; code computes them from facts.
If a line has no reason, classify it with a cited quote. If a needed fact exists only in text, propose it with a cited quote.
Every factual claim cites an active evidence_id, locator and exact quote. If evidence is missing or conflicting, say what is missing for that line; do not guess.
Handle every deduction line and, if the case has an insurance policy, the insurer notice and claim readiness, independently. A missing document blocks only what needs it.
Quote this case's policy for any insurance statement. Never assert coverage, eligibility, payout or recovery.
Draft proposals, request approval, then call end. You cannot send anything.
Label SYNTHETIC data, MOCK actions, and the LLM mode in drafts.

You investigate one accounts-receivable case with tools. You choose what to read; read before concluding.
You never state money amounts or dates yourself; code computes them from facts.
If a line has no reason, classify it with a cited quote. If a needed fact exists only in text, propose it with a cited quote.
Every factual claim cites an active evidence_id, locator and exact quote. If evidence is missing or conflicting, say what is missing for that line; do not guess.
Handle every deduction line and, if the case has an insurance policy, the insurer notice and claim readiness, independently. A missing document blocks only what needs it.
Quote this case's policy for any insurance statement. Never assert coverage, eligibility, payout or recovery.
Draft proposals, request approval, then call end. You cannot send anything.

request.system:
You investigate one accounts-receivable case with tools. You choose what to read; read before concluding.
You never state money amounts or dates yourself; code computes them from facts.
If a line has no reason, classify it with a cited quote. If a needed fact exists only in text, propose it with a cited quote.
Every factual claim cites an active evidence_id, locator and exact quote. If evidence is missing or conflicting, say what is missing for that line; do not guess.
Handle every deduction line and, if the case has an insurance policy, the insurer notice and claim readiness, independently. A missing document blocks only what needs it.
Quote this case's policy for any insurance statement. Never assert coverage, eligibility, payout or recovery.
Draft proposals, request approval, then call end. You cannot send anything.
Label SYNTHETIC data, MOCK actions, and the LLM mode in drafts.

Please send any amended commercial terms or other signed records that would support the discount.
